race.title: Call Star Sports On 08000 521 321 Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: FERRET JEETER proved a prolific winner last season and this C&D scorer looks to have been found an excellent opportunity to go in at the first time of asking back chasing. Melton Mossy wasn't foot perfect when successful at Stratford but could still prove the chief threat to Anthony Honeyball's likeable sort. FERRET JEETER MELTON MOSSY (IRE) ENJOY D'ALLEN (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Ferret Jeeter (1/1), Melton Mossy (2/1), Diplomatic Ash (6/1), Enjoy D'allen (8/1)
